segments.vo: We are college students now. Assignments, deadlines, placements.
But somewhere inside us, that little kid is still alive.
The kid who made paper boats in the rain.
Who shared tiffin with best friends.
Who played cricket till the street lights came on.
Who believed that anything was possible.
So today, let's not grow up too fast.
Happy Children's Day. To every kid, and to the kid inside all of us.
